intent.instruction: Create a torus with major radius 5 mm and minor radius 2 mm in FreeCAD, measure its surface area, include that measurement in the finished FreeCAD file, and save the completed document to /home/user/Unnamed.FCStd.
intent.engineering_extension: stored area responds to exposed native radius edits; separate from official task score

candidates.A:
torus_obj = doc.getObject("Torus")

# Calculate surface area
surface_area = sum(face.Area for face in torus_obj.Shape.Faces)

# Add a Float property to store the surface area as a number
torus_obj.addProperty("App::PropertyFloat", "SurfaceArea_mm2", "Measurements", "Surface area of torus in mm²")
torus_obj.SurfaceArea_mm2 = surface_area

print(f"Set SurfaceArea_mm2 property to: {torus_obj.SurfaceArea_mm2}")

# Also add a descriptive string property
torus_obj.addProperty("App::PropertyString", "MeasurementNote", "Notes", "Surface area measurement note")
torus_obj.MeasurementNote = f"Torus with major radius 5mm, minor radius 2mm has surface area {surface_area:.4f} mm²"

print(f"Set MeasurementNote property to: {torus_obj.MeasurementNote}")
